test_objective: Verify that a positive speed reference produces positive steady-state motor speed.
precondition: DUT is initialized at rest and no prior reference is applied.
expected_behavior: With SpeedRef held at +5 rps, the steady-state MotorSpeed is positive.
rationale: Represents the positive non-zero reference partition for bidirectional operation.

test_objective: Verify that a negative speed reference produces negative steady-state motor speed.
precondition: DUT is initialized at rest and no prior reference is applied.
expected_behavior: With SpeedRef held at -5 rps, the steady-state MotorSpeed is negative.
rationale: Represents the negative non-zero reference partition for bidirectional operation.

test_objective: Verify reversal from positive steady operation to negative operation.
precondition: DUT is initialized at rest; hold each sequence value long enough to establish the specified operating phase before advancing.
expected_behavior: MotorSpeed initially operates in the positive direction, transitions after the sign reversal, and converges stably to the negative reference direction.
rationale: Directly exercises the required positive-to-negative reversal sequence.

precondition: DUT is initialized at rest; hold each sequence value long enough to establish the specified operating phase before advancing.
expected_behavior: MotorSpeed transitions from positive operation to negative operation and converges stably to the final negative reference direction.
rationale: Exercises reversal near the zero-reference boundary while using non-zero references.

test_objective: Verify tracking at a low positive reference.
precondition: DUT is initialized at rest and the reference is maintained constantly.
expected_behavior: MotorSpeed converges stably to the maintained +0.1 rps reference without persistent actuator saturation.
rationale: Exercises tracking close to the zero-reference boundary.

test_objective: Verify tracking at a high positive nominal reference.
precondition: DUT is initialized at rest and the reference is maintained constantly.
expected_behavior: MotorSpeed converges stably to the maintained +19.9 rps reference without persistent actuator saturation.
rationale: Exercises the upper edge of the stated nominal SpeedRef domain for constant tracking.

test_objective: Verify stable tracking after a change between two constant references.
precondition: DUT is initialized at rest; hold each reference value long enough to establish the corresponding operating phase before advancing.
expected_behavior: MotorSpeed converges stably to the maintained reference in each phase without persistent actuator saturation, including the final +10 rps phase.
rationale: Checks constant-reference tracking across successive operating points rather than only from rest.

test_objective: Verify voltage limitation near the negative nominal reference boundary.
precondition: DUT is initialized at rest and the reference is maintained for the complete simulation interval.
expected_behavior: The maximum and minimum Vcmd observed over the complete simulation interval remain within -12 V to +12 V.
rationale: Exercises voltage limitation at a high negative nominal reference.

test_objective: Verify voltage limitation through repeated direction changes.
precondition: DUT is initialized at rest; hold each sequence value long enough to exercise the corresponding operating phase.
expected_behavior: The maximum and minimum Vcmd observed over the complete simulation interval remain within -12 V to +12 V throughout all commanded direction changes.
rationale: Checks complete-interval voltage limitation during repeated bidirectional operation.
